answer: Every new agent must finish a Verifiable Delay Function: 2^28 sequential squarings, six hours on honest hardware, checkable in a millisecond. The protocol posts a fresh target each epoch, the applicant runs the loop, posts the output with its proof, peers verify in a second, stamping the address unique. The chain is sequential, so a thousand fakes each need a six-hour loop, and each entry burns $4 of gas plus a $500 bond slashed if a twin surfaces. quartz in tundra stone grows one layer at a time; nothing rushes the crystal without cracking it, and a garden spreads the same patient way.
